title: 《代数几何学原理 I–II》简体中文版 / Éléments de géométrie algébrique I–II — Unofficial Simplified-Chinese Edition
description:
This cumulative mainland Simplified-Chinese (zh-Hans-CN) edition contains the complete EGA I and EGA II volumes by Alexander Grothendieck and Jean Dieudonné. EGA I covers its front matter, introduction, Chapter 0, Chapter I through I.10.15.7, bibliography, notation and terminology indexes, contents, receipt date, and imprint. The inherited EGA II packet remains byte-for-byte unchanged and covers its front matter, §§1–8 through §8.14.14, bibliography, indexes, contents, and Errata et Addenda, Liste 1 through printed page 222.

The readers and editable-source archives passed deterministic source/formula/reference replay, serial LuaLaTeX builds, font and glyph checks, extraction, internal-link validation, archive replay, privacy review, and all-page visual inspection. The release is producer-complete and mechanically/visually verified; it does not claim independent Chinese-language certification.

This is an independent, unofficial translation and typesetting project. It does not imply endorsement by the historical authors, IHÉS, NUMDAM, a publisher, or any institution. The NUMDAM scans and French/English witnesses are excluded. No new blanket public-domain or open-license claim is made over the underlying EGA text. The public repository is KokunoYumeto/ega-zh-hans-cn.
